title.narrative: Saudi 'Noor' Volunteer Project for Blindness Prevention - Specialized Operations

description.narrative: Perform specialized surgical operations in the eye socket (orbit). Supply patients' needs for medication, glasses, and lenses as required. Relieve the suffering of many people affected by blindness. Provide health education to all who receive treatment, for prevention.
Provision of medical services in the field of blindness prevention and its causative diseases, for low-income beneficiaries who cannot cover the cost of their treatment.
Disbursement for "Saudi 'Noor' Volunteer Project for Blindness Prevention - Specialized Operations" in Yemen, implemented by Al-Ramadi Association
